comparison.objective: Configure a date stamp from a work order and make one correct permanent impression; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Read a date, rotate detented wheels, ink, orient, and press once without smear versus align and stabilize a mandrel, hammer with controlled force, and recover fragments.
comparison.success_condition: One correctly configured, upright, unsmeared box impression and stamp returned to cradle versus four safe fractures, four contained tangs, intact hardware, and stable release.
comparison.reason: Both involve consequential tool application, but configuration-and-printing is a different central ability from notch fracture and loose-part containment.
